recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It applies the missing part of the final Jira intent in active ServiceRequest narrative source and aligns the narrative with the existing ServiceRequest.subject conformance definition.
issue_request: FHIR-50610 was Applied with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked to move the sentence about ServiceRequest use for groups, devices, and environmental locations higher in the ServiceRequest Scope and Usage section, to spell out Computerized Physician Order Entry (CPOE), and to remove the procedure-performer sentence from this ServiceRequest-focused section.
initial_application: The related FHIR-47458 scope rewrite introduced the group/device/environment sentence lower in source/servicerequest/servicerequest-introduction.xml. The apparent FHIR-50610 application, PR #3511/commit 632359314841ba8b9810fa6bb1b101661a10f5cb, spelled out CPOE and removed the procedure-performer sentence, but it deleted the group/device/environment scope sentence instead of moving it into the opening paragraph.
additional_context: ServiceRequest is active in source/fhir.ini, and ServiceRequest.subject already allows Patient, Group, Location, and Device with a definition covering animals, groups, devices, and environmental locations. OO WGM minutes for 2025-05-12 record the FHIR-50610 persuasive-with-modification vote. Zulip searches found no directly relevant or conflicting discussion.
